rules.text: Respect the host project existing design system before adding a new one.
Use the minimum number of libraries needed.
Give each selected library one clear ownership role.
Prefer Bklit UI for charts and data visualization.
Prefer existing CSS/component-native motion before Anime.js for trivial effects.
Use Rive only for meaningful interactive vector/state-machine graphics with known asset rights.
Do not combine daisyUI with another base system without an explicit strategy.
Never vendor or redistribute React Bits component source from OrchestrUI.
Never silently use paid/Pro material or credentials.
Accessibility, responsiveness, performance and coherence outrank novelty.
